cabinet_electrical_envelope.limits: Engineering corners, not measurements. Check current, leakage, pulse shapes and gate margins across installed temperature/load, including SSR thermal derating, exact specified DC-only -D-H switching performance, cabling and the actual flyback load.

reset_and_idle_qualification: pre-held RESET, early press during idle qualification, break-before-make travel and proper re-arm passed

short_trip_reclose_inhibit.timer_bypassed_counterexample: With KEN and KS held in position, OEM releases first; B welded and normal maintained A can restart upon STOP release.
short_trip_reclose_inhibit.out_of_envelope: For a pulse shorter than capture or too much auxiliary skew the bypass counterexample can recur. No timing values were measured on the installation.

sensitivity_and_limits.enable_seal: additional KEN bridge plus retained A and B can permit restart after the delay
sensitivity_and_limits.enable_output: additional KEN bridge plus retained A and B can permit restart after the delay
sensitivity_and_limits.trip_gate_short: additional short can allow pickup during remaining KS mechanical release time; no single-fault safety rating
sensitivity_and_limits.pilot_gate_short: additional short can allow pickup during remaining KS mechanical release time; no single-fault safety rating
sensitivity_and_limits.frozen or welded automatic outputs: no guaranteed automatic stop; factory STOP still trips
sensitivity_and_limits.retained upstream A demand masked by KFB: fresh manual enable can restore A; B or factory pickup still needed

conventional_24V_pilot_proof_calculation.scope: Conventional continuously supplied 21.6–26.4 V DC pilot, coil 70–150 ohm. Bench qualification pending.

assumptions: Conventional 24 V DC OEM pilot, compatible auxiliaries and OPEN_STOP firmware. One electrical installation, settled contact states.

Settled cases allow the relays and timer to release. Short STOP/overload cases separately freeze KEN/KS and credit an independently powered KT1 reclose blank only inside its specified acceptance envelope. Actual switch travel, bounce, timing and coast remain unmeasured.
Relay travel normally settles before the 1 s idle proof matures; loss of timer supply resets this delay per the timer's physical specification.
Open-position transfer and captured-key service interlock require physical verification. No unattended overflow protection or safety integrity rating is inferred.
